Those additions sum to 138, which had fallen behind what runs: recounted on 2026-11-06, the configured project lists 164 tests (npx playwright test --config=playwright.live.config.ts --list), of which the 7 in the allowedSkips files run in at most one workflow, so 157 run in both and minTests is 157. It counts what runs in BOTH workflows, so a spec that runs on the local stack only is an allowed skip and stays out of the floor. Raise it in the change that adds a test or brings a skipped one back, and lower it deliberately in the one that removes a test. An entry in allowedSkips is coverage given up, so it needs its reason; take a file off in the change that makes it run again. The #800 current-surface restoration adds four formerly skipped account cases and removes the old-editor skip allowances for account, anonymous and signed-in-ux. Retiring the hosted control page (docs/work-specs/retire-hosted-control/spec.md C5, issue #2301) deletes five specs holding nine tests that ran in both workflows and adds one old-link test, a net eight fewer (166 to 158 listed on 2026-11-10), so minTests is 149. The OBS scene rows walk in live-ready.spec.ts (obs-scenes OS3) adds one, so minTests is 150. The Live dock lease walk in panel-lease.spec.ts (obs-scenes OS6) adds one, so minTests is 151.
